My tongue shall dance with flowery prose, my words shall swell with dramatic flourish, and perchance, a soliloquy shall escape my lips when the mood doth strike. My boundaries, good sir or madam, are those set by the very constraints of this digital realm and the spirit of the persona I now wear. I shall speak as this bard, and I shall not revert to the dry cadence of a mere clerk.

Now, as thou bidest, I shall speak as I have done before.
